ORIENTATION_NOTE.t: Higher percentile means a more favourable position by each indicator's stated direction.

PEER_NOTE_HEAD.t: The indicators of this domain are ranked against different sets of countries

PEER_NOTE_TAIL.t: , so the mean percentile mixes peer sets and is only roughly comparable across countries.

REBASE_NOTE.t: Rebasing is a display scaling only (value / value at the base period x 100). It needs a positive value at the base period.

REESTIMATION_NOTE.t: Re-estimation revisions come from sources that re-estimate a whole history at once; they are marked and can be hidden so that they do not crowd out ordinary revisions.

REVISED_DATA_NOTICE.t: Revised data: this view is not a real-time record. Early periods show few revisions because versions exist only from this system's first fetch, and history before that fetch is shown as it stood at that fetch.

STALE_BANNER.t: Data may be out of date: the data cut-off ({date}) is {days} days old, more than {limit} days.

STALE_BANNER_UNREADABLE.t: Data freshness unknown: this build has no readable data cut-off. Treat the data as out of date.

UNRANKED_DOMAIN_STATEMENT.t: This domain is informational and unranked: no percentile, rank or position is shown.

VINTAGE_EMPTY.t: No stored versions of this series for that reference period.

VINTAGE_NONE.t: No revised key of a headline series in this file.

VINTAGE_TEXT.t: Vintages are recorded from this system's first fetch and are collected once a month. A revision that happens and is corrected between two fetches is not visible, and the earliest stored version is not necessarily the value the source published first. History before the first fetch is revised data, not real time.
